# Fallout 76: Interview with Jonathan Rush in London 2024

![Fallout 76: Interview with Jonathan Rush in London 2024](/uploads/427_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

In London on November 12th, 2024 I not only had the opportunity to take part in this great event, meet Bethesda Germany and see new features, I also had the opportunity to meet Fallout 76 Creative Director Jonathan Rush and Executive Producer Bill LaCoste in person. And not only that, I was even able to ask the questions from the London Event post directly to Jon Rush. I was very happy about this surprising, great opportunity. If someone had predicted this to me 2 weeks before, I wouldn't have believed them.

Many thanks to Bethesda Germany Community Management!

## Interview with Jon Rush (Fallout 76 Creative Director)

### New map expansions

**Nuka Knights:** Since we got a nice new map expansion with Skyline Valley, we can imagine further map expansions in the forest, Toxic Valley, swamp, etc. Do you already have plans for that?

**Jon Rush:** The great thing about Skyline Valley is that by expanding the map, by expanding the boundaries of our Appalachia, we've been able to tell more of the story of Appalachia. I always saw this as a main character, but at the same time giving the players the opportunity to tell their own stories.

Through building camps and exploring and adventuring and so on. So a real expansion of the map. Our players really enjoyed it. We also loved it because it brought so much to us as developers. So, do more of this in the future? In any case. I mean, it was discussed what the specific plans are. I can't really say.

But the kind of updates that give us the opportunity to do that and our players the opportunity to do the same are definitely what appeals to us the most.

**Nuka Knights:** Okay, I'm looking forward to that.

### Loadout change via Pipboy

**Nuka Knights:**We love using different loadouts and switching them quickly with the punch card machines, but would it be possible to add some sort of loadout switching option to the Pip Boy?

**Jon Rush:** Possibly. Is there a reason why you don't want to go to the punch card machine?

**Nuka Knights:** Well it's easy, if you have Fallout 1st then you have the Survival Tent. But if not, then it might be a problem for some players. So, I have Fallout 1st, that's not a problem. But there are also some places where it is difficult to change.

Maybe it would be more convenient to switch in certain situations or during combat if you decide: Okay, my rifle ammo is empty, but I have heavy weapons and power armor with me and I switch builds during combat. Something like that.

**Jon Rush:** It's certainly an interesting idea. In Gleaming Depths we have a passage area between encounters. And in every transit area we have punch card machines for people who want to re-spec their skills. Think about those who want to develop their own style of play.

Maybe you could make it this convenient with PipBoy. I think it would be worth discussing. I think it's an interesting idea.

### Changing game currency

**Nuka Knights:** There are many endgame players sitting on huge amounts of in-game currency such as caps, gold bars, stamps and perk coins. Would it be possible to add some sort of currency exchange machine where players can exchange one currency for another?

**Jon Rush:** Oh, like, yeah, like a change machine?

**Nuka Knights:** Yes, for coins, stamps or whatever.
